benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The |J|-max and Fiedler rounds are not rerun and their verdicts are not edited.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..67 were used in earlier rounds; 80 and above stay unused; k=100 and 101 were round-1 held-out instances and are not used
forbidden: using fidelity to choose the packing

families.KM_pack: shared gamma, thetaK, thetaM, three shell angles per layer, |J|-max triples, 3+3L
families.nodata_fid: shared gamma, Fiedler triples, seed provider, 1+3L
families.K_fid: shared gamma, Fiedler triples, seed provider, 2+3L
families.KM_fid: shared gamma, thetaK, thetaM, three shell angles per layer, Fiedler triples, 3+3L
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-3 standard budget

packing_abs: exact maximization of the sum of |J_ij| on the three edges of each triple, lexicographically smallest sorted partition on ties within 1e-12. Same partition at every layer.
packing_fiedler: Laplacian of |J|, numpy.linalg.eigh, second-smallest eigenvector, sign so the largest-magnitude entry is positive with the smallest site index on magnitude ties, order by (coordinate, site index), contiguous triples, each triple sorted, the list of triples sorted. Abort if the gap to the next eigenvalue is below 1e-8.
union_rule: At each N, k, and L, take the lower energy of the two repeats inside KM_pack, and the lower energy of the two repeats inside KM_fid. Keep the lower of those two states. If the energies are equal, keep KM_pack. This choice is made after both fits, from energy only, and is the same rule at N=6, 9, and 12. The searches do not use each other's values as starts.
architecture: cavity X frame, one gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell angles per layer, same UcX at every layer. K is the original pair-square of the full J. M is the original block mean of the packing used by that circuit.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]

seeds.note: Same integer prefixes as the round-4 runner. k=68..79 were not fit before. family_index is the position in family_order. Extra QAOA repeats use r=2 and r=3 in the same formulas.

continuation: Each KM family: Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients times (L-1)/L, perturbations N(0,0.1) and N(0,0.3), two ramps, nested seed from its own K family. QAOA: Zhou interpolation, append-zero, perturbations, two ramps, and the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05).
selection: lowest energy. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in packing, features, starts, beam, or the union.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 instances with both primary repeats complete

secondary_equal_search.role: reported only, not part of the verdict
secondary_equal_search.note: QAOA keeps its lowest energy over four repeats. The union still uses two repeats of each packing.

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: primary repeats r=0,1 first, k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6; then QAOA-only repeats r=2,3 in the same N order
